messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: control-plane.gateway error-rate elevated > 8% (5xx) across us-west-2 for last 3m. Paging oncall: @arnav. Incident ID: CP-2149998765
arnav (oncall): on it. initial triage: are errors concentrated on specific endpoints? any customer-facing impact?
Mia Chen: support seeing a handful of support tickets — customers report 502/504 on LLM API calls (generation and embeddings). Linking a sample: https://support/redwood/ticket/5591
Luis (Support): confirmed. ~12 distinct customers in last 10m. Severity: user-visible errors, some high-traffic tenants retrying.
Jordan SRE: metrics: increased 5xx at control-plane.gateway -> traces point to auth-service and config-service timeouts. error breakdown: auth 45%, org-lookup 30%, billing 15%, config 10%. root cause unknown.
Ravi (ENG): I can tail auth and config logs now. starting with auth.
Ravi (ENG): auth logs show repeated upstream 502 from auth-db-proxy: 
```
ERROR auth-handler: upstream response status=502, id=ab12cd, latency=1203ms
WARN auth-cache: failed to fetch user key, err=timeout
```
Ravi (ENG): config service traces show many requests stuck waiting on billing-check RPC returning 504.
Jordan SRE: stacking hypotheses: (1) billing downstream degraded -> causes config/auth to block -> gateway 5xx cascade, (2) sudden traffic spike + long tail RPCs -> saturating connection pool. Need quick mitigations.
arnav (oncall): mitigation plan (short): 1) enable circuit-breaker/failfast for billing-check RPCs (degrade to cached allow) 2) scale config and auth replicas + bump connection pool 3) enable fallback auth variant (auth-lite) for reads 4) temporarily raise gateway retry budget. Who will run each?
Ravi (ENG): I can flip auth -> auth-lite for read-only token checks. prepping a canary.
Mia Chen: I can coordinate support comms and gather customer timestamps.
Jordan SRE: I'll change circuit-breaker thresholds and scale config/auth via k8s HPA. running kubectl now: 
```
kubectl scale deploy auth-service --replicas=8 -n controlplane
kubectl scale deploy config-service --replicas=6 -n controlplane
```
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered: scale auth-service -> 8 replicas by Jordan SRE. ID: deploy-2149998765-1
Ravi (ENG): auth-lite canary up on two pods, routing 5% traffic. Observing errors on canary: success so far.
Jordan SRE: circuit-breaker updated for billing-check RPCs to failfast after 200ms and fallback to cached-check. Pushing policy: 
```
circuit.breaker.billing.threshold_ms = 200
circuit.breaker.billing.fallback = true
```
Alyssa (PM): any user-visible mitigation yet? need ETA to tell customers.
Jordan SRE: within 2-3 minutes after scaling and CB changes error rate dropped to ~2.1% and customer reports decreased. continuing to watch.
Luis (Support): sharing interim note to impacted customers: "We're aware of elevated errors affecting API calls, mitigation in progress. We'll send an update in 20 minutes." :mailbox_with_mail:
arnav (oncall): good. keep monitoring for 15m. If stable, we'll keep new config and schedule postmortem.
Ravi (ENG): digs deeper: billing service had a deploy 8m before page, introduced a regression causing slow RPCs under certain cache-miss patterns. Opening PR revert now.
Ravi (ENG): revert PR created and tested in staging. Plan: rollback billing deploy to previous stable. need owner to approve immediate rollback.
Alyssa (PM): approve rollback. prioritize availability.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for billing-service by Ravi (ENG). Rollback ID: rb-2149998765-1
Jordan SRE: watching telemetry... billing RPC p95 dropped from 1.5s -> 120ms post-rollback. control-plane gateway 5xx back to baseline 0.3% in 4m.
Mia Chen: customers reporting API success again. patchy reports resolving.
Luis (Support): updating ticket batch: all affected customers notified of mitigation and planned postmortem.
arnav (oncall): who will own post-incident notes and timeline? we need impact window, root cause (billing deploy), mitigation steps, and action items (improve canary, add RPC SLAs, better fallback).
Ravi (ENG): I'll draft the postmortem and include stack traces and the failing commit hash.
Jordan SRE: I'll add timeline, metrics, and mitigation runbook updates.
Alyssa (PM): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups for any enterprise accounts.
arnav (oncall): handing off to next oncall in 30m. summary for handoff:
- Incident ID: CP-2149998765
- Start: 2149998765 (alert from gateway)
- Mitigation: scaled auth/config, enabled circuit-breaker for billing-checks, canary auth-lite, rolled back billing deploy
- Customer impact: 12 customers reported 502/504s, error rate peaked at 8.7% for ~9 minutes, most impacted between 2149998765 and 2149998820.
- Current status: stable (5xx ~0.3%). continue 30m watch.
- Action items: improve billing deploy canary, add RPC latency alarms, document fallback policy, add more robust read path for auth.
arnav (oncall): tagging next oncall: @sre-next please pick up monitoring window.
sre-next: acknowledged, will monitor and open follow-up ticket.
Mia Chen: note for handoff: support will follow up with a CS API summary and per-tenant log extracts.
Ravi (ENG): dropping the failing trace IDs here for postmortem: ab12cd, ef34gh, zx90kl
Jordan SRE: saving logs to incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/CP-2149998765/logs.tar.gz
Mia Chen: thanks everyone. :heart: will keep the channel updated if anything regresses.
arnav (oncall): closing active mitigation. please file postmortem and link here within 48h. :white_check_mark:
